Name: Produce to Sapling - Fizzy Drinks for PFM
Author: metalax
Description:
Uses the Producer Framework Mod to permit tree produce to be processed into saplings at the seed maker.

One additional sapling is given for each quality level.

Regular: 1
Silver: 2
Gold: 3
Iridium: 4

This mod covers all tree produce from the 'Fizzy Drinks' mod.

[size=4]Installation:[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install [url=https://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5342]Fizzy Drinks[/url]
[*] Unzip the download and move the [code][PFM] Produce to Sapling - Fizzy Drinks[/code] folder into [code]../Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].
[*] Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Created with Stardew Valley 1.4 on Windows. Should be fine on Linux/Mac.
[*] Due to PFM only permitting one active rule for each combo of input and machine, if any other PFM mods that add 'Fizzy Drinks' tree produce interactions with the seed maker are installed, only the first one loaded will function. This can be overridden, but the mod to be overridden must be specified by the overridding mod. As such, a compatibility patch will be required. Drop a post with a link to the other mod and I'll see about making a compatibility patch.
[/list]
